ImageDescription.value: View of Hansnes, the administrative centre of Karlsøy Municipality (Karlsøy kommune) in Troms og Finnmark county, Norway. The village is located on the northeast side of the island of Ringvassøya, along the Langsundet strait. The photo shows the pier (terminal, fergeleie, kaia) for the car ferry service (bilferga) from Hansnes to the nearby islands of Karlsøya, Vannøya, and Reinøya. Also seen are the Ringvassøy Church (Ringvassøy kirke), etc. Photo taken on May 6, 2019, in the spring of Northern Norway.
